title: Reusing formal Vlasov-Maxwell proofs to certify plasma solver outputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI now produces machine-checked mathematics faster than researchers can read it. Can such theorems do practical computational work? We reuse one from \mbox{OpenAI's} Lean~4 relativistic Vlasov--Maxwell library: initial fields determine the field at an outside point until plasma signals reach it, and the energy leaving a surrounding box before they reach its faces. New Lean proofs and numerical bounds give particle-free references for particle-in-cell simulations across three tasks. Domain size follows analytically from observation time, exposing boundary and initialization errors in WarpX and Smilei that global energy checks missed. Grid choice can be tested directly: combining two coarse grids recovers unknown plasma inputs within tolerance at a median 14.9-fold speedup over a fine grid, where the medium grid alone fails. For reduced models, the bounds establish the minimum number of time curves needed to predict energy loss.

translated_title: 复用形式化Vlasov-Maxwell证明来认证等离子体求解器的输出
translated_abstract: 如今，AI生成机器校验数学的速度已超过研究人员阅读它的速度。这样的定理能否完成实际的计算工作？我们复用了OpenAI的Lean 4相对论性Vlasov–Maxwell库中的一个定理：初始场决定了外部某点的场，直到等离子体信号到达该点为止；同时给出了在该信号到达包围盒各面之前离开该包围盒的能量。新的Lean证明和数值界限为粒子模拟的三项任务提供了无粒子的参考基准。域大小可通过解析方式由观测时间导出，从而揭示了WarpX和Smilei中全局能量检查所遗漏的边界误差和初始化误差。网格选择可以直接测试：在容差范围内，组合两个粗网格能够恢复未知的等离子体输入，相比细网格获得中位数14.9倍的加速，而仅用中等网格则会失败。对于约化模型，这些界限确定了预测能量损失所需的最少时间曲线数量。
tldr: 该论文将OpenAI Lean 4相对论性Vlasov–Maxwell库中的机器校验形式化证明复用为粒子模拟的无粒子参考基准，可暴露WarpX和Smilei求解器中被全局能量检查遗漏的边界与初始化误差，并通过组合粗网格以中位数14.9倍加速实现可验证的等离子体模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper reuses machine-checked Lean proofs from OpenAI's relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell library as particle-free reference bounds to certify particle-in-cell plasma solver outputs, exposing boundary and initialization errors missed by global energy checks and enabling verified coarse-grid simulations with a median 14.9-fold speedup.
